findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: 1ST REPEAT: Observed that the seam between the dry storage wall and the floor was only sealed on one side (the side opposite the door) but not the side next to the door. Seal the dry storage wall to the floor on all sides to ensure a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-201.13(A) Floor and Wall Junctures, Coved, and Enclosed or Sealed. (A) In FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS in which cleaning methods other than water flushing are used for cleaning floors, the floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1 mm (one thirty-second inch). [C]
